Five countries will send troops to support a US-led armed force in Gaza as
part of Donald Trump's dystopian "peace" plan, US officials announced
Thursday, as world leaders convened in Washington, DC, to determine the future
of Palestine without input from Palestinians.

The announcement came at the inaugural meeting of Trump's "Board of Peace."
Trump [claimed](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/2/19/trumps-
board-of-peace-live-representatives-converge-for-inaugural-meeting) in his
speech that the "war in Gaza is over," despite Israel's repeated violations of
the supposed "ceasefire" deal he negotiated. Israel has killed at least 611
Palestinians since agreeing to the truce in October 2025.

Major General Jasper Jeffers, the commander of the so-called International
Stabilization Force for Gaza,
[confirmed](https://x.com/dropsitenews/status/2024523906594320687?s=46) at the
meeting that Indonesia, Morocco, Albania, Kazakhstan, and Kosovo have pledged
to send troops to the ISF. Indonesia, which is preparing 8,000 troops to
deploy, will also be deputy commander of the force.

Jeffers [said](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/five-countries-
commit-troops-gaza-international-security-force-commander-says-2026-02-19/)
the long-term plan is to train 12,000 police and have 20,000 ISF troops.
Forces will deploy to Rafah first, he
[added](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/2/19/trumps-board-of-
peace-live-representatives-converge-for-inaugural-meeting).

Two other countries, Egypt and Jordan, pledged to train a "trustworthy"
Palestinian police force to take over local security,
[according](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/live-
blog/trump-board-peace-gaza-iran-dhs-ice-elections-epstein-live-updates-
rcna259104) to Trump.

Israel - whose military is responsible for the genocide and decimation of Gaza
to begin with - is one of least 27 countries that have joined Trump's "Board
of Peace."

Several European countries, including France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, and the
UK, have refused to join, and [according to ](https://time.com/7379643/trump-
board-peace-countries-joining-rejected-invitations-
membership/)_[TIME](https://time.com/7379643/trump-board-peace-countries-
joining-rejected-invitations-membership/)_ , over a dozen other nations have
been invited but their responses have not yet been announced.

Trump has [pledged](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/02/19/us/trump-news) $10
billion from the US for the so-called "Board of Peace," which critics say
could be a slush fund since he'll be the one controlling it. Azerbaijan,
Bahrain, Kazakhstan, Kuwait, Morocco, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab
Emirates, and Uzbekistan are collectively
[contributing](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/2/19/trumps-board-
of-peace-live-representatives-converge-for-inaugural-meeting) $7 billion.

According to the United Nations, the Gaza Strip remains illegally-occupied
territory.
